## Public-reporting status after the transaction (feasibility-relevant)
- On January 24, 2019, Calpine Corporation filed a Form 15-12B certifying termination
  of registration under Section 12(g) / suspension of the duty to file reports under
  Sections 13 and 15(d) of the Exchange Act, covering its common stock and three series
  of senior unsecured notes (5.375% due 2023, 5.500% due 2024, 5.750% due 2025), each
  listed with one holder of record as of the certification date. [SRC: SEC accession 0000916457-19-000005, Form 15-12B]
- Despite that 2019 filing, Calpine continued to file periodic reports on EDGAR
  thereafter: its most recent Form 10-K (for fiscal year ended December 31, 2019) was
  filed February 25, 2020, and its most recent Form 10-Q (for the quarter ended June
  30, 2020) was filed August 13, 2020. [SRC: SEC accession 0000916457-20-000007, 10-K FY2019] [SRC: SEC accession 0000916457-20-000030, 10-Q Q2 2020]
- The SEC's submissions record for CIK 0000916457 shows no filing of any type dated
  after an August 21, 2020 Form 8-K; as retrieved, no 10-K, 10-Q, or other periodic
  report exists on EDGAR for fiscal year 2020 or any later year, meaning no SEC filing
  falls within the ~2021-2023 outcome window. [SRC: https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0000916457.json]

  outcome window, and the realized-record facts below rely on the company's own press
  releases rather than primary SEC filings. [SRC: https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0000916457.json]

## Realized business record under private ownership (press-sourced, within window)
- On February 3, 2023, the company (still operating and communicating publicly as
  "Calpine") announced it was commencing development efforts for a new approximately
  425 MW peaking facility adjacent to its existing Freestone Energy Center in Texas,
  citing a state regulatory framework (a Performance Credit Mechanism) adopted to
  incent new generation. [SRC: https://www.calpine.com/calpine-announces-initial-development-for-new-facility-at-freestone-energy-center/]
- On December 14, 2023, Texas Governor Greg Abbott and ERCOT's CEO visited Calpine's
  Houston headquarters as Calpine CEO Thad Hill announced the company's decision to
  proceed with advanced development and construction of that new 425-megawatt
  simple-cycle gas-fired plant adjacent to the existing 1,063-megawatt Freestone
  combined-cycle facility, targeted to be operational before summer 2026. [SRC: https://www.calpine.com/governor-abbott-joins-calpine-for-announcement-on-texas-power-investment/]
- The December 2023 announcement identifies Thad Hill as Calpine's CEO at that date —
  the same individual whose employment agreement with Calpine (entered May 2017) is
  discussed in the closing-era merger proxy — indicating continuity of that executive
  role through at least the end of the outcome window. [SRC: https://www.calpine.com/governor-abbott-joins-calpine-for-announcement-on-texas-power-investment/]

  Constellation Energy), but this figure spans a period beyond the fixed ~2021-2023
  window, is not broken out by year, and is not traceable to an audited primary
  financial statement; it is recorded here as [UNVERIFIED]. [UNVERIFIED]

  Calpine employee-count and revenue figures attributed to 2021; this could not be
  confirmed against any primary or directly-quotable secondary source and is
  therefore excluded from the sourced facts above. [UNVERIFIED]

- Because Calpine's duty to file periodic SEC reports lapsed after an August 2020
  Form 8-K with no subsequent 10-K, 10-Q, or other periodic filing on the public
  record, there is no public audited outcome record for the ~2021-2023 window; the
  traceable realized record is limited to two company press releases (February and
  December 2023) showing continued, expanding generation-development activity in
  Texas under the same CEO named in the 2017 closing-era proxy, with no documented
  divestiture, bankruptcy, or dissolution appearing in the retrievable public record
  for this window. [SRC: https://www.calpine.com/calpine-announces-initial-development-for-new-facility-at-freestone-energy-center/] [SRC: https://www.calpine.com/governor-abbott-joins-calpine-for-announcement-on-texas-power-investment/]
